text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraqi banks start hard currency exchange.
- Turkey is keen to reopen the Iraqi-Turkish oil pipeline.
- Vice-Chairman of the Revolutionary Command Council attends the graduation of post-graduated students.
- Iraq organises a national symposium on maternity.
- Activities of Babylon international cultural festival continue.
- A French official calls for ending embargo on Iraq.
- Oil Minister ridicules statement by senior U.N. inspector.
(The above stories were also carried by QADISSIYA and THAWRA)
- U.N. Secretary-General stresses that American troops violated the demilitarised zone between Iraq and Kuwait.
- Iraq's foreign minister continues his meetings with states' foreign ministers in New York.
- Iraq's representative in the Arab League said his country would resist any action meant to threaten its unity.
